scenes.title: Once a year, only once
scenes.subject_block: The high priest Aaron, small in golden vestments, stands alone before the towering curtained Tabernacle court at first light; behind and below him a vast hushed multitude of Israelites kept in shadow; immense pale sky; the sacred tent dominant and severe.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: I laid aside gold and glory
scenes.atmos: dust motes in a light shaft, faint smoke
scenes.subject_block: Still-life: a golden breastplate, ephod and priestly garments laid upon a worn stone bench in a single shaft of light; two weathered hands releasing the gold; plain folded white linen waiting beside it. No face, hands only.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: Plain white linen, like a servant
scenes.subject_block: Aaron, now in plain white linen, seen from behind, walking down a dim colonnaded passage toward a great heavy veil lit by hanging oil lamps; his back fully to us.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: I went in alone
scenes.atmos: smoke and cloud drift, pulsing golden glow
scenes.subject_block: Aaron's small linen-robed silhouette before an immense temple veil; through a narrow gap, thick darkness and a single faint golden glow of the mercy seat; the curtain towering and swallowing him.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: That he die not — the cloud upon the mercy seat
scenes.subject_block: The Holy of Holies: the golden ark and mercy seat between two great cherubim, a luminous cloud of divine presence above filling the dark chamber; one tiny prostrate linen-robed form at the lower edge, awed and small.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: I buried two of my own sons
scenes.subject_block: A unified memory tableau, soft-edged like remembrance. Foreground: Aaron's bowed grieving head and shoulders. Background memories dissolving softly into the dark: two fallen young priests amid strange-fire smoke; a shrouded body carried on a bier; an altar with a basin of blood and rising flame; the distant veil. Five soft vignettes, no panels or frames, all bleeding into one dim canvas.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: They brought me two goats, and I cast lots
scenes.subject_block: Two goats standing close together before the altar; a priest's weathered hands casting two small marked lot-stones over a bronze vessel; the markings only illegible scratches, not readable text; tabernacle court behind in shadow.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: The first goat I killed — blood within the vail
scenes.subject_block: Aaron in white linen carrying a shallow bronze basin of blood through thick darkness toward the faint golden glow of the mercy seat, his arm raised to sprinkle; seen from behind and side, the blood catching the light.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: Both my hands upon the live goat
scenes.subject_block: Aaron laying both hands upon the head of a living goat, his own head bowed low in confession; a robed 'fit man' waits at the edge; beyond the camp gate the open wilderness opens pale and vast. Aaron in profile, half-shadowed.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: I watched it go — a land not inhabited
scenes.subject_block: A vast bleached desert wadi to a hazy horizon; a single small goat walking away down the cracked valley floor, reduced near to a dark speck; at the near edge, seen from behind, a lone robed man watches it go, dwarfed by the emptiness. (Reuse the approved test_hero.png.)
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: One offering — yet it took two goats
scenes.atmos: smoke one side, dust and pale light the other
scenes.subject_block: One frame holding the riddle: on the left, the slain goat in blood-red altar light and smoke (the price); on the right, the live goat facing an open pale road into the waste (the guilt carried off); the altar standing dark between them. A single unified canvas, soft transition, no hard divider.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: Why two? — two things at once
scenes.subject_block: Aaron alone in the emptying court at dusk, turning the question over; behind him one altar still smoking and one empty road running out into the darkening waste; his face lined and contemplative, lit by a single low flame.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: The people went home clean
scenes.subject_block: A great multitude of Israel departing at evening, faces lifted and unburdened, walking away from the tabernacle into golden dusk; the crowd kept soft and in shadow, a sense of relief over the whole field.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: Every year I came back and did it again
scenes.subject_block: A unified tableau of weary repetition: Aaron at the altar repeated as soft ghosted echoes receding into the dark, the same act year upon year; the same two goats faintly doubled; turning seasons hinted in the sky; the same basin of blood; the worn altar stone. Five soft vignettes melting into one dim recurring canvas.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: I was only ever pointing — a sign
scenes.subject_block: Aged Aaron, older and weary, alone before the veil at night, looking up toward a faint far light he cannot reach; deep shadow all around; his upturned face caught in a thin edge of light, full of unspoken longing.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: A shadow waits for the body — the body came
scenes.subject_block: The long shadow of a cross falls across the old altar and the two goats, cast by an unseen figure of light off-frame; the shadow lengthens toward a luminous open doorway in the far dark; the old order dim, the coming light pale and growing. Ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern tabernacle interior. Absolutely NO physical cross, crucifix or wooden cross OBJECT anywhere in the scene — ONLY a faint cross-shaped SHADOW on the ground and the altar.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: By his own blood he entered in once
scenes.subject_block: Christ as the true High Priest, robed, seen from behind and side, passing through a torn radiant veil into holy light; he bears his own wounds rather than a basin of blood; darkness behind him, glory opening ahead. The fulfillment of the lone priest at the veil.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: The LORD laid on him the iniquity of us all
scenes.subject_block: A unified fulfillment canvas: the figure of Christ central, reverent, arms open; soft-edged to the left, a single goat lying still and at rest upon the low stone altar (the price paid) — absolutely NO blood, no gore, no wounds, no blood bowl, no red; soft-edged to the right, the scapegoat walking away into the pale wilderness (the guilt carried off); the two resolving into the one Priest at the centre; a faint cross of soft light above Christ. Ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, calm and reverent.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: He suffered without the gate
scenes.subject_block: Christ led outside the city gate: a lonely robed figure on a road beyond the walls, moving toward a barren hill, deliberately echoing the scapegoat's road into the waste; the city walls behind, the wilderness ahead; seen from a distance, his back to us.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: He sat down — the veil rent from the top
scenes.atmos: pouring light, falling dust, faint fabric stir
scenes.subject_block: Two truths in one frame: the seated High-Priest Christ at rest in glory at the right hand (the chair Aaron never had), and the great temple veil torn from the top downward by no human hand, light pouring through the painted rip. The tear is painted, still, not actively ripping.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: Do not come to me, or a goat, or an altar
scenes.subject_block: Aged Aaron in linen steps back and gestures away from himself and from the old altar and goats, turning the viewer's eye past him toward a distant growing light; he diminishes into shadow as the light beyond him grows.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: Come to Jesus — carried as far as east from west
scenes.subject_block: A lone everyman figure walks free toward the risen Christ, who waits with open hands in dawn light; behind the walking figure a dark burden is being carried off small to the far horizon, never to return; the road ahead bright and open.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: The way is thrown wide open
scenes.subject_block: The torn temple veil now fully open, brilliant light flooding out into the once-dark holy place; the path through it clear and inviting; no guard, no priest barring the way; the great curtain hanging painted and still, the opening ablaze.
scenes.style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork, ancient biblical-period Near-Eastern setting, no text, no modern elements, cinematic 16:9 widescreen.

scenes.title: Boldness to enter into the holiest
scenes.subject_block: Ordinary people of every kind, all in ancient Near-Eastern robes, tunics and simple head-coverings of the biblical period (NOT European or medieval dress, no peasant caps, no brimmed hats, no bonnets), draw near and step through the opened veil into the light, unafraid, where once only one man one day a year could go; kept soft and in gentle shadow so no single face dominates; a quiet procession into glory.

scenes.title: Will you come in? — be carried clean
scenes.subject_block: HERO CLOSE: the risen Christ stands in the full open doorway of light, the torn veil framing him, one hand extended toward the viewer in welcome; the way wide open behind him; warm, reverent, the whole frame resolving on his face and open hand. The landing.
